senses.gloss: (redupl. of כרב, v. כְּרוּב) to round off, to make a rim by hollowing out the centre (as on a mechanic’s stool, a pot-lid &c.).
units: <cite ref="Chullin 25a">Ḥull. 25ᵃ</cite> bot. unfinished wooden vessels <he>שעתיד … לכַרְכֵּב</he> which require polishing … or caving out; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:17">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 17</cite> <cite ref="K01191"><he>כרכב</he></cite> (read <he>לכ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:10">Ib. 10</cite> (of metal ware) <he>לכרכב</he>; <cite ref="Chullin 25b:1">Ḥull. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>לכַרְכֵּר</he> (Ar. <he>לכרכם</he>).
